subject: Co-sell SKU & billing mapping for cloud listing — launch readiness
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@stratussys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudOps Partnerships <partners@cloudops.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T14:03:22-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell readiness - SKU & billing mapping

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood runtime looks solid for our reps. Our marketplace program manager asked for a concrete SKU and billing mapping so they can create co-sell SKUs across AWS/Azure/GCP. Attached is a first-pass SKU spreadsheet (StratusSys_SKU_Mapping.xlsx).

High-level asks from our side: 
- Confirm Redwood's preferred meterable SKU names (we can alias) and the corresponding plan tiers you expect us to map to.
- Any non-standard billing semantics (min-bill, rounding window) we should propagate to the cloud listing.
- A list of required evidence for co-sell (certs, contract addenda) so we can attach to the listing.

Can we aim to have a short call this week to align? I can carve out 30 minutes Thursday morning PT.

Attachments: StratusSys_SKU_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx)

—Amit
Head of Partnerships, StratusSys Inc.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@stratussys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T16:22:10-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell readiness - SKU & billing mapping

Amit — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Looping in Ben (Commercial) and Laura (Partner Ops) to scope the mapping and evidence requirements.

Quick answers up front:
- We prefer per-seat and per-concurrent-session meters for most ISV listings; example SKU names are in the attached Redwood_CoSell_Playbook_v1.3.pdf (see section 2.1). We can publish aliases so your portal shows Stratus-friendly labels.
- Billing semantics: Redwood batches metering at 60s windows and reports usage hourly to marketplaces. No minimum billing, but some cloud marketplaces require a $0.01 minimum line item — we can add a technical alias to satisfy that if needed.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report, data processing addendum (DPA), and a short security FAQ document typically suffice. Laura, can you confirm if we need the penetration test summary for GCP marketplace?

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to confirm commercial SKU-to-plan mapping and pricing bands. (Ben)
2) Laura to enumerate evidence artifacts and links to our shared Drive. (Laura)
3) Align on a 30-minute call Thursday 10:00 AM PT to finalize mapping and sign-off for marketplace submission. (All)

I attached our internal playbook to speed the review — it's the short checklist we use for co-sell packaging.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_CoSell_Playbook_v1.3.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit@stratussys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-12T08:10:05-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell readiness - SKU & billing mapping

Thanks — I'll take point on the pricing mapping. Quick notes from commercial: 
- For AWS and Azure we recommend three public plan bands (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) mapped to the per-seat/per-concurrent meters Amit sent. I'll populate the pricing bands in the sheet and return by EOD Tuesday.
- For GCP we need confirmation of whether Stratus wants metered billing or a flat subscription SKU; flat SKUs are easier for co-sell motions but reduce observability. Amit, is there a preference?

I can make the 10:00 AM PT Thursday slot — please send a calendar invite. Also, Soojin / Laura: I want to request a 1-page one-pager we can use for marketplace descriptions that highlights latency SLAs and dedicated routing options. Laura, can you draft?

—Ben
Director, Commercial Partnerships
From: Amit Shah <amit@stratussys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudOps Partnerships <partners@cloudops.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-12T10:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell readiness - SKU & billing mapping

Ben — thanks. For GCP we prefer metered billing (we lean into usage-based for technical customers). We want to keep parity across clouds where possible.

I created a draft mutual action plan and attached a DocuSign link for the partner addendum (we need signatures to attach to the marketplace listing): https://www.docusign.com/txn/ABC-9943.

I'll join Thursday 10:00 AM PT.

—Amit
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-15T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Post-call actions — StratusSys co-sell readiness

Recap from Thursday: good alignment. Actions for Redwood: 
- Ben to finalize pricing bands and populate Stratus sheet (deadline: 2028-05-18).
- Laura to upload SOC 2 link, DPA template, and penetration-test summary to the shared Drive and send the Drive link to Amit (deadline: 2028-05-17).
- Soojin to approve final playbook language and push playbook + 1-pager to the partner portal once Ben confirms pricing.

I'll mark this thread as active in HubSpot and attach the signed addendum once DocuSign clears. Laura — please include the Drive link in your reply so Amit can attach evidence to the marketplace submission.

Thanks team — close coordination on this will keep the co-sell cadence tight.

Soojin
